protocol: Post-inference only. Official devkit GT/pred class-range/point/rack filters; display score>=.25; same-class XY<2m; preserve previous valid match then Hungarian; raw tracks without interpolation. Teaching IDSW are not official IDS.
selection_rule: For each split and FP/FN/IDSW separately, choose greatest strictly negative (improvement) and strictly positive (degradation) Opti-minus-GRAE delta; earliest frame tie break. Omit absent directions. No tuning.
